_comment: Every binary entry the published tarball is allowed to carry, one entry per file. Consulted by check_pack_size's binary-eligibility predicate; an entry is ALLOWED only when every mechanical condition in that predicate holds, so a row here is a claim the gate re-verifies rather than a permission it grants. Path-exact by construction: no wildcards, no directory grants, and a second row for the same path is a hard failure. AUTHORITY: AI council 2026-09-08, 2 seats, unanimous, deep tier — it reopened the `binary` class that f573d628c closed 24 hours earlier. `archive` is NOT reopened and this file may never carry one: that collision supplied zero evidence about archives.

entries.why: The PHP grammar the code-graph engine loads. ADR-259 ships the parsers so a consumer install can build a graph with no manual step; compiled WebAssembly is the only form a grammar has, and the production loader reads these exact bytes.
The TypeScript grammar, which also serves .tsx. Same reason as the php entry.
